headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: High-impact display font, aggressive tracking for massive sizes.

rules: Limit the use of Primary color; use mostly for CTAs or electric highlights.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use matte black surfaces with glowing 1px borders.

implementation: Borders: 1px solid #1f1f1f, highlighting active elements with #00FFCC.
Effects: Use a subtle CRT scanline effect (repeating-linear-gradient) over hero backgrounds.
Glow: Add drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,204,0.5)] on active buttons or 'Coming Soon' text.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: bg-black/50 maximum. If using an image, let the cyberpunk vibe shine through.

components.strategy: HTML/Tailwind for storefront pages for max creativity; Shadcn customized for forms/checkout/admin.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), 1px neon border, black background, neon text. On hover: bg-[#00FFCC] text-black.
components.inputs: Shadcn Form & Input. bg-surface, border border-zinc-800 focus:border-[#00FFCC] rounded-none font-mono.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular edges. 1px border. No heavy drop shadows; use subtle inner glow or neon border for interaction.
components.marquee: The Kinetic Texture: Fast-moving text with Unbounded, massive outline text (text-8xl+) in the background of Shundo Hunting section.

storefront.rule: Leave empty cells for offset alignment. Emphasize 'Event Passes' with row-span-2.

dashboard.rule: Every pixel utilized, strict hierarchy. Use border-collapse style layouts for tables.

rules: Do NOT use transition: all. Be specific: transition-colors, transition-transform.
Hover states: slight lift (-translate-y-1), neon border illumination.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering list elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glowing elements remains readable (use #000000 for text on #00FFCC backgrounds).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-ptc-input').

hero.description: Shadowy hacker figure with glowing screens.
Person wearing eerie neon LED mask.

3d_libraries.description: Use TSParticles in the hero section to create floating digital 'dust' or a mesh network, mimicking a dark web hacker vibe.

general_instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, dark-mode gaming e-commerce platform for a hacker-forum demographic.
DO NOT build generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for the storefront.
DO NOT use 'transparent' background for headers. Use bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1f1f1f].
For the PTC Username/Password form on checkout, give it a 'terminal' aesthetic: JetBrains Mono font, black background, green/cyan 1px border.
Implement conditional validation warning in the cart if 'Event Pass' is added without 'Currency Bundle'. Show a neon-red error message.
Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/duotone) for a premium hacker feel. DO NOT use emojis.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and key elements for testing.
Do not use standard generic UI. Make it look like a high-end underground marketplace.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications with a custom dark theme (bg-black border-cyan).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
